Load in necessary packages 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

This is to practise using the round function
```{r}
num_1 <-  3.14159 
round(num_1)
```
This is to practise argument order using the repeat function 
```{r}
#Ordered
print(rep(5, 7)) 
#Keywords
print (rep(x = 5, times = 7))
```
This is to practise variable types 
```{r}
numerical <- 13 
character <- "Biology"
logical <- TRUE 
#Print numerical value and class 
print(numerical)
print(class(numerical))
#Print character value and class 
print(character)
print(class(character))
#Print logical value and class 
print(logical)
print(class(logical))
```
Using variables of different types 
```{r}
cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"
treated_1 <- TRUE 
treated_2 <- FALSE 
num_cells_before_1 <- 5415 
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123 
num_cells_after_1 <- 1432 
num_cells_after_2 <-7543
```
Exploring Quirks of R 
```{r}
print(TRUE + TRUE)
print(TRUE + FALSE)
print(5+ TRUE)
x <- NA 
print(x==NA)
print(is.na(x))
x <- 0/0 
print(x)
print(is.na(x))
print(is.nan(x))
print(round(2.5))
print(round(3.5))
```
Using Vectors 
```{r}
cell_ID <- c(cell_ID_1, cell_ID_2)
treated <- c(treated_1, treated_2)
num_cells_before <- c(num_cells_before_1, num_cells_before_2)
num_cells_after <- c(num_cells_after_1, num_cells_after_2)
```

Accessing Vectors 
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")  
fav_pet <- all_my_pets[4]
print (fav_pet)

```
Vectorisation 
```{r}
x <- c(2, -4, 6, -2)
x*2 
x>5 
sum(x)
abs(x)
```
Data Frames 
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  cell_ID <- cell_ID, 
  treated <- treated, 
  num_cells_before <- num_cells_before, 
  num_cells_after <- num_cells_after 
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```
